name: 劉建宏
objective: This course is designed to introduce concepts and skills essential in the database systems. Relational database will be the main focus with related topics such as relational model, design concepts, and structured query language. The topics to be covered include: introduction to database systems, record storage and file organizations, indexed structures for files, the relational model, relational algebra and calculus, SQL, conceptual and logical design for relational database, functional dependencies, normalization and database management system technology.

7     SQL
8     Midterm Exam
9     Project Presentation
10    More SQL
11    Functional Dependencies and Normalization
12    Relational Database Design Algorithms
13    Practical Database Design Methodology
14    Disk Storage and Basic File Structures
15    Indexing Structures for Files
16    Final Exam
17    Project Presentation
18    Project Presentation
彈性學習(17-18週):
類別
		  
		    ● 學生分組實作及討論 (Student group practice and discussion)
● AI 輔助學習與工具應用 (AI-assisted learning and tool application)
		  
      

      
        內容
        
          學生分組進行專題報告、系統展示、以及回答教師提問，包含如何使用 AI 工具進行專題實作與報告。
